character.description: The same young adult male anime protagonist: silver-grey hair in a cropped, feathered cut, violet eyes, a gentle face with focused eyes; a field-tested futuristic courier, wearing a sleek technical jacket with luminous piping, fitted utility trousers, and compact gear with pastel pink accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in empty mall atrium with palms, glowing fountain and statue, escalators into the sky; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with pastel pink, aqua, lilac, chrome silver; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by symmetrical wide shot down a mall atrium, slow tracking along a fountain, low shot of reflective floors; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
